# GPT-6.1 Terra — full pricing reference (checked November 4, 2026)

## What is GPT-6.1 Terra?
GPT-6.1 Terra is OpenAI's mid-tier API model, released October 26, 2026, positioned above GPT-6 Luna and below GPT-6.1 Sol. Context window 1.05M tokens, up to 128K output tokens. It targets visual reasoning, writing and computer-use workloads.

## Complete rate card (per 1M tokens, Standard mode)
- Input: $1.00
- Cached input: $0.05
- Cache write, 30-minute retention: $1.25
- Cache write, 12-hour retention: $2.50
- Output: $5.00
- Prompt over 272,000 input tokens: input and cache rates x2, output x1.5, applied to the whole request
- Batch / Flex mode: all rates x0.5
- Fast mode: all rates x2

## Comparison (Standard, per 1M tokens: input / cached input / output)
- GPT-6.1 Terra: $1.00 / $0.05 / $5.00
- GPT-5.6 Terra: $2.00 / $0.20 / $12.00
- GPT-6.1 Sol: $2.00 / no separate cached rate / $10.00
- GPT-6 Luna: $0.10 / no separate cached rate / $0.50

## Worked example
A cache-heavy agent session using 10M input tokens (97% cached) and 200K output tokens costs about $1.79 on GPT-6.1 Terra, versus about $4.94 on GPT-5.6 Terra, $3.57 on GPT-6.1 Sol and $0.23 on GPT-6 Luna (cache writes excluded).

## FAQ
Q: How much does GPT-6.1 Terra cost per million tokens?
A: $1.00 input, $0.05 cached input, $5.00 output. Cache writes $1.25 (30-min) or $2.50 (12-hour).

Q: What is the 272K surcharge?
A: Any single request with a prompt over 272,000 input tokens bills the entire request at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output.

Q: Do Batch and Flex halve the price?
A: Yes, every rate halves ($0.50 input, $2.50 output per 1M tokens).
